# Archived Workflows

This directory contains build workflows for services that have been consolidated into larger services.

## Consolidated Services

The following services have been consolidated into **QaliTrack.MasterData**:
- customer-service → `build-customer-service.yml`
- driver-service → `build-driver-service.yml`
- product-service → `build-product-service.yml`
- report-service → `build-report-service.yml`
- route-service → `build-route-service.yml`
- sacco-service → `build-sacco-service.yml`
- supplier-service → `build-supplier-service.yml`
- transporter-service → `build-transporter-service.yml`
- vehicle-service → `build-vehicle-service.yml`
- weighbridge-service → `build-weighbridge-service.yml`

These workflows are preserved for historical reference but are no longer active. The consolidated service is built using `build-qalitrack-masterdata.yml`.
